subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

State prosecutors allege that Salim took efforts to __**hide**__ his actions from his legal staff.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Conceal" **means to hide or keep something secret. (छिपाना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tried to** conceal** her disappointment when she did not win the prize
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'hide'** is **'conceal'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exposed** (प्रकट): Make something visible by uncovering it.

 
 
• **Example:** The investigation exposed the corruption within the organization.
 
 
 
• **Apparent** (स्पष्ट): Clearly visible or understood; obvious.
 
 
• **Example: **It was apparent that the project would not be completed on time.
 
 
 
• **Bare** (नंगा): Not covered or clothed; exposed.
 
 
• **Example:** The bare branches of the trees swayed in the wind.
